subject: ACK: Hint reveal aria-expanded + auto-rescue announcement (spec 20260224-0100)
body:
Implemented. Commit: 9e3c4be.

P3 accessibility gaps addressed:
1. Hint button now has id='hintBtn-{qId}-1' + aria-expanded='false'
2. showHint() layer 1: sets aria-expanded='true'
3. triggerRescue(): injects temporary sr-only div with aria-live='polite', text 'Hint revealed. Check below.' -- removed after 3s

Layer progression (HIDDEN/L1/L2/L3/AUTO_RESCUED) unchanged.

Ready for GD QA.
